description: ConStrain is Pacific Northwest National Laboratory's Python tool for checking time-series behaviour of building controls. It combines a control-verification algorithm library, preparation and case-generation workflows, and performance evaluation and reporting. Inputs are observations or simulated component behaviour; outputs identify whether selected control functions satisfy the encoded checks. Coverage is globally configurable for building systems, with time resolution and test periods inherited from the input series. Public source, notebooks and API documentation are free under BSD-2-Clause. A limitation is that the verification library is described as preliminary and covers selected requirements from ASHRAE Guideline 36-2021 and 90.1-2016. It does not establish complete building-code compliance. Implemented checks include supply-air temperature, economiser operation, zone setpoints and water-temperature resets. ConStrain can test outputs of building-energy simulations, complementary to EnergyPlus (model-energyplus). Its README cites the 2026 JOSS software paper and distinguishes model verification from field-control use. Unrelated candidates containing the ordinary word constrain are not matches. No building time series or verification cases were executed.
